title: Aletheia: Quantifying Cognitive Conviction in Reasoning Models via Regularized Inverse Confusion Matrix
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith/religion. It focused on quantifying 'Cognitive Conviction' and detecting 'sycophancy' (a model's tendency to agree with user fallacies) in reasoning tasks, specifically using mathematical and medical contexts.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a subject of the study.
